evidence.detail: SIDEBOARD_WEIGHT = 0.2 applied uniformly to all sideboard cards in every playability aggregation
preaggregate_season_archetype_playability uses (maindeck + sideboard_only * SIDEBOARD_WEIGHT) — no special case for companions or wish targets
COMPANIONS = search.search('is:companion') — companion list is computed but not referenced in playability module

triage.notes: The decision requires agreeing on what weight companions (always accessible from sideboard) and wish-accessible cards deserve relative to ordinary sideboard cards — that is a product/algorithm judgment, not a clear bug.
